name: Conflict Girl
source:
——On a humid day in June, the air thick with the promise of the rainy season.
It all started when she asked that girl to help her study for an upcoming exam.
Her gentle smile reminded her, just a little, of her late mother——

As summer break approaches, Nozomi Aikawa, a high school freshman, asks her neighbor and classmate, Satsuki Shinozuka, to help her study for her final exams.
Satsuki always wears a calm, gentle smile, but as they grow closer, Nozomi begins to notice cracks in that facade. It’s as if she’s carefully hiding something behind her kindness, enduring it all in silence.
Nozomi finds herself drawn to the fragile, fleeting quality of the girl who reminds her so much of her late mother.

——It’s raining.
Just like that day, it’s been raining since morning——

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ420839.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
——六月，潮湿的空气中，已透出梅雨将至的气息。
一切始于她请那个女孩，帮忙准备即将到来的考试。
对方温柔的笑容，让她隐约想起已故的母亲——

暑假将近，高一学生相川Nozomi请邻居兼同班同学筱冢皋月，帮助自己复习期末考试。
皋月总是带着平静温柔的微笑，可随着两人逐渐亲近，Nozomi开始察觉那副面容上的裂痕。仿佛她小心地将什么藏在温柔之后，默默承受着一切。
那位与已故母亲如此相像的女孩，身上脆弱而转瞬即逝的气息，让Nozomi越发着迷。

——下雨了。
就像那一天，从早晨起，雨就一直下着——
